svg.aria-label: Before, every sample of the tile runs the edge tests c greater than 0 and r greater than 0, even far from any edge. After, the first row and the first column are decoded by their own loops with the tests, and the interior loop reads W, N and NW with no tests at all.
svg.text: every sample tests for the edge
three tests per sample, c > 0 and r > 0, even far from any edge
first row and column peeled off
